datePolicy: Source access date 2026-11-06 is explicitly supported by the original source register (Seoul/Singapore local date; some receipts are 2026-11-05 UTC). No external access was repeated for localization; copy editing is not a price, legal or availability refresh.
uncertainties: No 2027 foliage forecast was verified. The 2026 JMC city-level representative-tree dates are not transferred to travel-year gardens or treated as a peak-colour promise.

Hotel minima are undated advertised one-night prices for three adults in one room seen 2026-11-06, not 2027 two-night quotes or verified availability. Restrictive plans, actual tax, cancellation, accessible bathroom/lift routes, usable beds and bag storage need checking.

Walking totals, route times, taxi ranges, car waits and crowd strategies are estimates/judgments, not live traffic or a personalised mobility assessment. No site is promised empty or wholly step-free.

Junsei suitable ground-floor chair seating is unconfirmed; priority admission does not guarantee a table. Menu dates/opening and chair allocation need checking. Ukihashi is a dated alternative whose ordinary table, lift route and thresholds also need confirmation.

Shoseien continuous step-free loop, Nanzenji aqueduct approach and independent Hojo access are not verified. Garden wheelchair loans cannot be reserved or guaranteed. Stop/omit options are integral to the plan.
Fees, fares, hours, senior-ID acceptance, exceptional closures, weather and future operations need rechecking. Botanical Garden closure is not every Friday; senior discounts are conditional.

The budget excludes Shinkansen, souvenirs, extra alcohol, paid Nanzenji interiors and two-room lodging; high-end taxi totals exceed the transport allowance and consume reserve. No booking, account or contact was made.
editingContract: Complete reader-first English and Simplified Chinese with exact numeric/date/external URL multiplicity and corresponding table-cell parity. Local draft only; no Review, stars or public attachment promises.
